mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_model_calls(call_id,trace_id,span_id,business_node_id,actor_user_id,task_id,source_json,record_json,created_at,expires_at) VALUES(#{args[0]},#{args[1]},#{args[2]},#{args[3]},#{args[4]},#{args[5]},#{args[6]},#{args[7]},#{args[8]},#{args[9]}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE call_id=call_id
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_model_calls SET record_json=#{args[0]} WHERE call_id=#{args[1]} AND actor_user_id=#{args[2]} AND trace_id=#{args[3]}
mapper.select: SELECT call_id,source_json,JSON_REMOVE(record_json,'$.diagnostic') AS record_json,expires_at FROM ai_model_calls WHERE trace_id=#{args[0]} AND actor_user_id=#{args[1]} AND business_node_id=#{args[2]} ORDER BY created_at,call_id LIMIT #{args[3]} OFFSET #{args[4]}
SELECT call_id,source_json,record_json,expires_at FROM ai_model_calls WHERE trace_id=#{args[0]} AND actor_user_id=#{args[1]} AND call_id=#{args[2]}
SELECT payload_id,state,ref_json,expires_at FROM ai_model_call_payloads WHERE call_id=#{args[0]} AND direction=#{args[1]}
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_model_call_payloads SET state=#{args[0]},ref_json=#{args[1]} WHERE payload_id=#{args[2]} AND state='WRITING'
mapper.select: SELECT chunk_no,char_offset,char_length,raw_length,codec,checksum,content FROM ai_model_call_payload_chunks WHERE payload_id=#{args[0]} AND chunk_no=#{args[1]}

SELECT chunk_no,char_offset,char_length,raw_length,codec,checksum,content FROM ai_model_call_payload_chunks WHERE payload_id=#{args[0]} AND char_offset+char_length > #{args[1]} ORDER BY chunk_no LIMIT 2
SELECT model_text_state,model_text_chars FROM ai_model_call_payloads WHERE payload_id=#{args[0]}

SELECT segment_no,char_offset,char_length,raw_start,raw_end,checksum FROM ai_model_call_text_segments WHERE payload_id=#{args[0]} AND char_offset >= GREATEST(0,#{args[1]}-8191) AND char_offset+char_length > #{args[1]} AND char_offset < #{args[2]} ORDER BY char_offset LIMIT #{args[3]}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM ai_model_call_text_segments WHERE payload_id=#{args[0]} ORDER BY segment_no LIMIT 128
mapper.select: SELECT payload_id,call_id FROM ai_model_call_payloads WHERE expires_at<=#{args[0]} ORDER BY expires_at LIMIT 32
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_model_call_payloads SET state='EXPIRED' WHERE payload_id=#{args[0]}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM ai_model_call_payload_chunks WHERE payload_id=#{args[0]} ORDER BY chunk_no LIMIT 32

DELETE FROM ai_model_call_payloads WHERE payload_id=#{args[0]} AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ai_model_call_payload_chunks WHERE payload_id=#{args[0]}) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ai_model_call_text_segments WHERE payload_id=#{args[0]})
DELETE FROM ai_model_calls WHERE call_id=#{args[0]} AND expires_at<=#{args[1]} AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ai_model_call_payloads WHERE call_id=#{args[0]})
DELETE FROM ai_model_calls WHERE expires_at<=#{args[0]} AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ai_model_call_payloads p WHERE p.call_id=ai_model_calls.call_id) ORDER BY expires_at LIMIT 32
